summary.name: MotionCasa
summary.one_liner: MotionCasa turns 5-8 real estate listing photos into AI camera-motion clips and assembles them into ready-to-post reels for $19 per listing with no subscription.
keywords: day to dusk real estate video
use_cases: Turn listing photos into a short social media reel
Add a video deliverable to a property photography shoot
Create vertical, horizontal or square listing videos from existing photos
Make a listing video without scheduling a videographer
Produce a branded or MLS-clean property video
summary.what_it_does: MotionCasa takes 5-8 listing photos (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MiB each) and renders one 5-second AI camera-motion clip per photo, such as a push-in, lateral pan or orbit. The clips are then assembled into reels with titles, music and branding across six templates. Output can be exported as 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1, and changing templates, text or music does not cost additional credits. A free browser preview plays a simple pan-and-zoom of photo order without uploading anything; AI rendering requires Google sign-in and purchased credits. The page also offers day-to-dusk and drone-style effects as paid redos at 150 credits each.
notable: One-time $19 per listing pricing with no subscription and no watermark on finished reels
Each photo gets its own AI camera-motion clip rather than a pan-and-zoom slideshow
Six reel templates and 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 exports generated from one set of clips
Free local browser preview of photo order that uploads nothing
caveats: AI-generated clips may alter rooms, geometry and details, so they do not replace an in-person viewing and must be checked against the photos
Finished videos are not refunded for dissatisfaction; redos cost 150 credits each
AI rendering requires Google sign-in and a credit pack purchase; batches above eight photos are not supported
AI source clips are generated at 720p
